svg.aria-label: Colophon — Set in TypeScript. Composed with Next.js, React, Astro & Svelte. Styled with Tailwind. Bound with Supabase, PostgreSQL & Prisma. Printed on Node & Vercel — with a little Ruby on Rails in the margins.
